sources: Baseball Savant (xERA, xwOBA, ERA, wOBA — season to date)
MLB Stats API (K%, BB% from season stats)
ATC (projected FIP from user's Excel upload)
Fangraphs ROS DC projections — ATC DC / The BAT X / OOPSY DC / ZiPS DC (FIP)

unified_score.method: rolling-led in-season core (stabilized 0.6*L5 + 0.4*season xFIP/SIERA + xERA/botERA), blended vs projection with a DYNAMIC weight w_season = IP/(IP+K) that grows with innings (K_good=15/K_bad=250, SP+RP asymmetric); plus a small rolling K-BB% trend nudge; plus a velo+CSW LEVEL adjustment (historical-panel recalibration).

stuff_era.fallback: no Stuff+ -> drop term; non-stuff renormalize to 62/32/6

rolling_blend.note: per-population B3 (Fable 2026-08-24): SP 0.6/0.4, RP 0.2/0.8 (emitted from constants)
